intent.premise: A ~100-second snowy New Year's Eve healing short in the flat yukie woodblock-print style: Tsumugi carries a roasted sweet potato up to a small shrine, finds a shivering fox cub by the offering box, shares half, hears the distant New Year bells, and promises to come back with the first snow next year — told through approved 2D keyframes, 2D crop moves, procedural flat-shape yukie layers (snowfall, breath fog, sweet-potato steam, lantern flicker), energy-gated Chinese viseme cels for the girl's monologue, and a slow music-box score.
intent.audience: Viewers evaluating a compact but complete 2D anime short with a stable generated heroine, a consistent fox cub, a readable approach-to-farewell progression, and synchronized sound.
designPriorities: Keep Tsumugi's vermilion coat, cream scarf and earmuffs, and dark-brown bob stable across every frame; the fox keeps its orange-red coat, cream chest, and white tail tip.
Use hard cuts for all beats; reserve the single closing crossfade for the final wide shot.
No A/B leg-swap walk cycles: walking reads through static cels plus crop moves, and the departure uses a near/far two-cel cut (walk-director selection rule).
Gate visible closed, half, and open mouth cels at 12 fps from the exact post-trim final dialogue stem, never from subtitle duration.
Derive frame selection, mouth state, crop motion, transitions, and subtitles only from absolute story time so seeks and segmented renders remain deterministic.
Draw every procedural layer (snowfall, breath fog, steam, lantern flicker) as razor-clean flat vector shapes in source-image space; zero grain, zero gradients, per STYLE_BIBLE.md.

intent.location: A small mountain-shrine approach at night: vermilion torii, snow-covered stone steps, stone lanterns, and a wooden offering box under the eave, all baked into full-frame 2D artwork.
intent.timeOfDay: New Year's Eve night during the first snow, lit by warm stone lanterns.
intent.storyFunction: Approach, discovery, sharing, the distant bells, and the promise to return.
visualRules: Every source PNG fills the 1920 by 1080 presentation canvas through cover-crop without aspect-ratio distortion.
The keyframe timeline, rather than equal frame division, determines every image boundary and camera-like crop move.
Each spoken line keeps one stable speaker plate; only a tight mouth rectangle changes between closed, half, and open states.
Chinese subtitles are rendered in code over text-free source art and must remain inside the lower safe area.
The scene uses a CanvasTexture as the Three.js background, so runtime camera collision geometry is intentionally inapplicable and camera obstacles remain empty.
Tsumugi and Fox are voice-only story performers whose visible bodies are baked into the keyframes; no 3D character meshes may be layered over the artwork.
No runtime grain, noise, or texture layer may be composited over the yukie artwork.
